Since \(a_n-a_1=(n-1)d\) and the given condition gives \(a_n-a_1=\frac{n-1}{2}\), we have
\[
d=\frac12.
\]
Thus
\[
S_n=\frac n2\left(2a_1+(n-1)\frac12\right)=\frac n2\left(2a_1+\frac{n-1}{2}\right).
\]
Then
\[
S_{20}=10\left(2a_1+\frac{19}{2}\right)=20a_1+95,
\]
\[
S_{10}=5\left(2a_1+\frac{9}{2}\right)=10a_1+\frac{45}{2}.
\]
So
\[
S_{20}-2S_{10}=(20a_1+95)-(20a_1+45)=50.
\]
\[
\boxed{50}
\]
